ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within $ \triangle ABC$, $ AD$ is the altitude on side $ BC$, $ CE$ is the median on side $ AB$, $ DG \perp CE$ at $G$, $CD = \frac{1}{2}AB$, and $DE$ is connected. Given that $BC = 13$, $CD = 5$, and $CG = EG$; what is the area of $\triangle BEC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because BC=13, CD=5$,\\
$\therefore AB=10, BD=BC-CD=13-5=8$,\\
$\therefore AD=\sqrt{AB^{2}-BD^{2}}=\sqrt{10^{2}-8^{2}}=6$,\\
$\therefore S_{\triangle ABC}=\frac{1}{2}BC\cdot AD=\frac{1}{2}\times 13\times 6=39$,\\
$\because CE$ is the median to side $AB$,\\
$\therefore S_{\triangle BEC}=\frac{1}{2}S_{\triangle ABC}=\boxed{19.5}$.
